# davetha/aiter-cdna2

**Binary-patches AMD AITER (officially CDNA3+) to unlock its fast paths on CDNA2.**

**Use it if:** You have MI210/MI250X-class GPUs and want the AITER kernels that most MI210 performance work depends on.
